# CrossPoint Reader 1.5.0-8

This Xteink X4 maintenance release fixes the reading-session summary shown when entering sleep and improves the book-statistics controls.

## Fixed

- The sleep transition now receives the completed reading-session duration before the reader activity closes, so the “I read” summary is displayed correctly.
- The clear-statistics action now uses the more appropriate `list-x` icon instead of a confirmation checkmark.

## Notes

- Reading sessions shorter than one minute with no page turns remain intentionally excluded from statistics and do not produce a session summary.
- This release contains firmware for Xteink X4 only.
